g.text: Local rare mass sums features below the selected abundance threshold within each sample
The measured rare-biosphere mass is threshold dependent
The highlighted 0.1% rule gives a 44.2% equal-sample mean (range 23.3–59.4%). Points are samples; lines connect descriptive group means without hypothesis tests.
